sloka: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं रावणो भीमविक्रमः ।संरक्तनयनः क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.५७ ।।।।
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyaṁ rāvaṇo bhīmavikramaḥ ।saṁraktanayanaḥ krodhādidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.59.57 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana of truly fierce valour, hearing Hanuman's words, his eyes became blood red and spoke to Hanuman this way.
